links.comparator_used: Standard screening practice (two radiologists read independently, a third resolves discordance)
links.outcome: Cost-effectiveness (cost per additional cancer detected) of AI as independent reader alongside one radiologist, with a second radiologist for discordance
links.effect: Integrated strategy was dominated in the base case. Scenario analyses using randomized controlled trial estimates showed AI-supported screening was more effective but more costly than standard practice (ICER $1123 per additional cancer detected).
links.tradeoff: Higher cost with no advantage in the base case. Any benefit appeared only in the trial-based scenario analyses.
links.quote: Integrated and Triage Single were dominated.

design_hint: AI-human triage and integrated reading workflows
